Class PathCompletionRecovery

java.lang.Object
org.firstinspires.ftc.teamcode.pedro.auto.PathCompletionRecovery
public final class PathCompletionRecovery extends Object
Checks path completion and retries navigation from the current pose. This class does NOT handle localization communication errors. The caller must ensure that follower.pose() is reliable.

    • PathCompletionRecovery

      public PathCompletionRecovery(com.pedropathing.follower.Follower follower, PathCompletionRecovery.Clock clock, double positionToleranceInches, double headingToleranceDegrees, double idleGraceSeconds, int maxRetries, double noProgressTimeoutSeconds, double maxAttemptSeconds, double minProgressInches)
      Configures completion verification and retry behavior.
      Parameters:
      follower - Pedro follower
      clock - elapsed-time source
      positionToleranceInches - allowed XY error
      headingToleranceDegrees - allowed heading error
      idleGraceSeconds - delay before attempting recovery
      maxRetries - maximum retries for each navigation task
      noProgressTimeoutSeconds - timeout for no progress
      maxAttemptSeconds - max timeout for path duration
      minProgressInches - minimum distance to the target allowed for progress

    • update

      public PathCompletionRecovery.Result update(double remainingNavigationSeconds)
      Checks arrival and retries an incomplete path. Monitors navigation and recovers from incomplete or stuck paths. Call once per loop after follower.update(), but only when localization data is reliable.
      Parameters:
      remainingNavigationSeconds - remaining retry time budget
      Returns:
      navigation result
